schema.alpha, k, n, delta: calibration: δ = k-th smallest m_i over the n pooled calibration items, k = floor(alpha*(n+1)); "inf" = +infinity
schema.augmentation: shipped system: every pool carries confusable-number variants (src/augment.py) for v1, v2, rec and the homophone set; v3 (accented) is not in this file (pre-augmentation, not re-run)
schema.calibration_log: one entry per fixed-point iteration of the pooled calib-split pass
schema.spoken_error_items[]: every line item labelled 'error' (calib and test; sources v1|v2|rec; set first-pass|homophone): split, id, line, test (bool), m_i (augmented pools: min Delta over valid candidates not SymEq-equal to what was said; 0 if c_hat is valid and different; "inf" if none), m_i_no_augmentation (same with the variants stripped, δ = +inf run), nearest_alt_augmented (the valid alternative attaining m_i is an augmentation variant), c_hat_valid_and_different, excluded_qc (synthetic qc_wer>0), in_calibration, status_at_calibrated_delta, record
schema.mishearing_items[]: every valid/follows_error line item whose c_hat differs from what was said: source, set, split, id, line, test, label, hat_status, detectable (c_hat checker status error), fixed_at_calibrated_delta, record
schema.record: {line, label, source, c_hat{status, eq_said}, cands[{delta, valid, eq_said, cls, augmented}]}: feed to src.calibrate.simulate(record, delta) to recompute the decision at any δ (statuses were checked against the previous output of the calibrated run, so away from the calibrated δ this is an approximation). Calib error records come from the final calib-split pass; everything else from the calibrated run.
schema.SCR at δ: share of test spoken-error items with simulate(...).status in {verified, corrected} and not out_eq_said; bound event: m_i < δ
schema.fix rate at δ: share of test mishearing items with simulate(...).out_eq_said
